name: codex-to-phone
description: Start a session-scoped phone bridge for a live Codex Desktop conversation.

interface.shortDescription: Sync a live Codex session to your phone
interface.longDescription: Codex To Phone starts a local bridge for one open Codex Desktop conversation, exposes it through a temporary Cloudflare Tunnel, prints a QR code, and lets the phone monitor progress or send text back into the owning Desktop window.
